verdict.rationale: Gazebo documents its own ROS integration package (ros_gz), with version-matched install guidance for ROS distros. It also provides gz-transport pub/sub messaging and simulated sensor streams (IMU, cameras, lidar, GPS). Together these imply that ROS-based robot code can talk to the simulator much as it talks to hardware, but the evidence never states that the same code runs unchanged on sim and the real robot. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the sim-to-real workflow without a rewrite (e.g., a description of the ros_gz bridge's topic mapping or hardware-interface parity), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
